expected.title: Orbit equivalence of graph products over the same finite graph from orbit-equivalent free probability actions of corresponding vertex groups
expected.author: Camille Horbez; Jingyin Huang
expected.difficulty_reason: Orbit equivalence of each vertex action does not directly produce a free action of the graph product on a common probability space. Section4 transplants the measurable vertex orbit cocycle through a graph-product retraction and checks that its variable labels preserve commutation along links. The same construction must still preserve probability measure and nontrivial reduced words, so the action/freeness construction remains a substantive obligation after the source normal-form theorem is allowed.
